title: Inès delivers strength and honesty in new single "Sans toi"
htmlContent: Independent artist Inès welcomes you into a space of quiet resilience and deep feeling with her new single, "Sans toi." A union of Pop, R&B, and Soul, this is very much an intimate letter, one addressed to the self in times of silence and solitude. "Sans toi" is an invitation to "listen to the silences within and that's precisely what it feels like. Her voice hovers somewhere between vulnerable and brave, making for a performance that feels both intensely private and utterly relevant. It's a song about being alone, and about the spaces where pain once lived, and one finds hope. https://open.spotify.com/track/00N4ulwYk1rlZKZpCIscMe?si=dEI8iMMPRfmu7_C0GXfneg Working entirely alone, Inès sculpts every note and word with meticulous attention to detail, and that honesty bleeds right through the production. "Sans toi" is about reopening and returning to oneself in a relatively low-key, unspoken act of strength that allows us to keep getting up and moving forward even when no one is looking. By going solo, Inès proves with this release that independence is a form of freedom. "Sans toi" is tender yet firm, introspective, and empowering, a soul-soothing anthem for anyone who has learned how to make peace with their own company. Follow Inès on Instagram
